iru: I looked in at the Iruña for the gang and they were not there, so I walked on around the square and back to the hotel.
Across the square the white wicker tables and chairs of the Iruña extended out beyond the Arcade to the edge of the street.
We went out to walk around under the arcade to the Café Iruña for coffee.
We had coffee at the Iruña, sitting in comfortable wicker chairs looking out from the cool of the arcade at the big square.
I was sitting over at the Iruña reading the papers when I saw Robert Cohn coming across the square.
We went down the stairs and out of the door and walked across the square toward the Café Iruña.
irun: At Irun we had to change trains and show passports.
